title: Intuition Vectors from Pretrained Representations Steer Diffusion-Based Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.32619v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Abstract visual reasoning requires identifying relationships between few examples and applying them to novel inputs. Recent advances have been driven by large language and vision-language models or specialized domain-specific architectures. It remains unclear whether abstract reasoning can be supported directly by the relational geometry of pretrained visual representations, without relying on language-based inference or task-specific representation learning. We investigate this possibility using frozen self-supervised vision encoders. With latent vector arithmetic, we confirmed that the representational geometry of two self-supervised encoders support abstract concept discrimination on Bongard problems and encode systematic relationships between input-output pairs in ARC tasks. translated_title: 来自预训练表示的直觉向量引导基于扩散的推理
translated_abstract: 抽象视觉推理需要从少量示例中识别出关系，并将其应用于新的输入。近期的进展主要由大型语言模型、视觉-语言模型或专门的领域特定架构所驱动。目前尚不清楚抽象推理是否可以直接由预训练视觉表示的关系几何结构来支持，而无需依赖基于语言的推理或任务特定的表示学习。我们使用冻结的自监督视觉编码器来研究这一可能性。通过潜向量算术，我们证实了两个自监督编码器的表示几何结构能够支持Bongard问题上的抽象概念判别，并在ARC任务中编码输入-输出对之间的系统性关系。图像嵌入之间的简单向量差——我们称之为“直觉向量”——能够捕捉在同类实例间泛化的变换。
tldr: 该研究发现，冻结自监督视觉编码器表示空间中的简单向量差（“直觉向量”）能够直接支持抽象视觉推理，无需依赖语言推理或任务特定的表示学习。
en_tdlr: This study shows that simple vector differences ("intuition vectors") in the representational geometry of frozen self-supervised vision encoders can directly support abstract visual reasoning, without relying on language-based inference or task-specific representation learning.
